playbook.claim: Test a low-priced, Claude-assisted ebook as the first purchase step for an audience that may resist higher-priced educational products.
playbook.mechanism: A lower-friction entry offer can convert initial curiosity into a paid customer while creating a measurable path to later products; compare low-price entry conversion, refund rate, repeat purchase, and downstream bundle uptake against a single higher-priced offer.

playbook.claim: Test a privacy-led relationship analysis flow that turns imported chat history into a relationship score, what-if reply simulation, and periodic report.
playbook.mechanism: A visible score and counterfactual reply suggestions make an ambiguous relationship feel inspectable, while on-device analysis lowers the perceived privacy cost; compare activation, report completion, premium conversion, and retention against a generic advice flow.

playbook.claim: Offer an anonymous question-box experience before asking users to start a direct conversation or paid session.
playbook.mechanism: An asynchronous, low-exposure first step lets hesitant users inspect real questions and responses before committing to chat or calls; compare question submission, return visits, direct-conversation starts, and paid conversion against a direct-chat-only onboarding flow.

playbook.claim: Test selectable AI relationship personas whose intimacy level develops through continued conversation.
playbook.mechanism: Persona customization gives users an immediate sense of ownership, while persistent intimacy progression supplies a reason to return; compare first-session completion, conversations per user, day-7 retention, and subscription conversion against a stateless chatbot.

ad_swipe.impressions_null_reason: Apple Search/Lookup storefront evidence does not provide impressions, installs, or revenue.
ad_swipe.why_it_works: The storefront frames the product as a repeated daily routine: users choose intentions, receive reminders, and use affirmations to address recurring negative thoughts. The promise is concrete and habit-oriented rather than a general wellness claim.
ad_swipe.replication_plan: Create an original storefront treatment around one daily intention, one reminder moment, and one visible affirmation completion state. Test intention-led screenshots and copy against generic inspirational positioning, measuring product-page conversion, onboarding completion, reminder opt-in, and day-7 retention without reusing the competitor's wording or visual assets.

ad_swipe.why_it_works: The treatment combines recurring visibility through a home-screen widget with customization and social sharing, giving the content both a private daily reminder use case and a distribution loop through shareable quote images.
ad_swipe.replication_plan: Test an original product-page sequence showing a personalized home-screen surface, a category or theme choice, and a shareable card. Compare widget-first, sharing-first, and routine-first screenshot orders using product-page conversion, widget activation, share events, and retained sessions as the decision metrics.
